# UI Tweens

> Tween library for Unity UI (uGUI) on Unity 6, an alternative to DOTween, PrimeTween and LitMotion for UI animation. Fluent extension methods (`DOAnchorPos`, `DOScale`, `DOFade`, `DOColor`...) on `RectTransform`, any `Graphic` (`Image`, `RawImage`, `Text`, TextMeshPro) and `CanvasGroup`, plus `Image` fill amount, with delays, loops (restart or yoyo), From and relative values, unscaled time, complete/restart/rewind, pause-on-disable, chaining, callbacks, 33 easing types and per-component pause, resume and cancel. Runs in an always-on LeoECS world with pooled entities. Requires classic LeoECS (`com.leopotam.ecs`). MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.
